meta.name: cloudbase-agent
meta.description: Build and deploy AI agents with CloudBase Agent SDK (TypeScript & Python). Implements the AG-UI protocol for streaming agent-UI communication. Use when deploying agent servers, using LangGraph/LangChain/CrewAI adapters, building custom adapters, understanding AG-UI protocol events, or building web/mini-program UI clients. Supports both TypeScript (@cloudbase/agent-server) and Python (cloudbase-agent-server via FastAPI).
